svg.title: Keyboard selection requires review before submission
svg.desc: Ctrl Alt K enters Control. The v key enters Select, movement only moves the cursor, and Space toggles a segment. Enter opens literal Edit without sending. Only explicit Ctrl Enter submits through the existing question handler.
